test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Five friends A, B, C, D and E work as a doctor, lawyer, Businessman, Engineer and Cook and live in Delhi, Mumbai, Goa, Panji and Punjab (not necessarily in the same order). The profession of no two friends is same and no two friends live at the same place. A works as a Cook but does not live in Goa and Panji. B and D live in Delhi and Mumbai respectively. C works as a lawyer. Doctor lives in Goa.

Which of the following combination is definitely TRUE?
solution:
Explanation:-

From the data we find that,

 
• A does not live in Goa and Panji, also Delhi and Mumbai are assigned to B and D. Therefore only city left for A is Punjab.
 
• Now we have doctor in Goa and rest other cities are assigned except for Panji and only person left is E who is a lawyer.
 
• Only E is not assigned any city or profession, so E is left with doctor and Goa.

Now we compare the options with the table drawn:

Option 1) **C - Panji - lawyer** -- It is true.

Option 2) **D - Mumbai - Engineer **-- There is no information of D being an Engineer.

Option 3) **A - Panji - Cook **-- A lives in Punjab. This option is false.

Option 4) **B - Delhi - Businessman **-- There is no information of B being an Businessman.

**Hence the correct answer is option 1.**
